item.title: Jev 1.14 and Kev-4B: a Better Classifier That Routes Pricier, and an Open Model That Almost Routes Like Jev
item.description: Jev 1.14 is a better classifier than 1.13 but routes about 10% more expensively, so I’m staying on 1.13. Kev-4B, with its temperature set inside the server, gets 86% topic, 74% risk and 67.5% of routes identical to gold, the closest any open model has come to Jev. At 3 seconds per decision, though. And Laya shipped 28 releases without touching its weights.

item.title: Clef-flash vs Jev: Cloudflare's Open Decision Model on a 16 GB MacBook
item.description: Three days after Cloudflare’s announcement, Clef-flash went through the same 80-prompt benchmark as Jev, Laya, Von and Kev. 90% topic accuracy, a confidence temperature that brings it level with Jev on calibration, and one problem no temperature can fix on a laptop.
